annotations.title: Resistor calculator: LED resistor, series/parallel, color code, Ohm's law

description: Resistor calculator: LED resistor, series/parallel, color code, Ohm's law — Electronics resistor helper with five modes picked by the params you send. LED: supply, vf (forward volts, or color=red|green|blue|white|ir) and ma (current) with optional count (LEDs in series) gives the exact resistor, the next standard E12/E24 value up, actual current, resistor power and minimum wattage rating, plus its color bands. Network: values=100,220,4.7k gives series and parallel totals; add target=3.3k for the best two-resistor E12 combination. Decode: bands=brown,black,red,gold (3-6 bands, incl. tolerance and tempco). Color code: value=4k7 gives 4-band and 5-band colors and nearest E12/E24. Ohm's law: any two of v, i, r, p. Accepts 4.7k, 4k7, 1M, 220R. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_resistor
